summary: Request metrics middleware now buckets path labels to a fixed set (/v1/..., /api/..., /health, /health/..., /backend-api/..., /internal/..., /other) using the root-path-stripped route path, and maps non-standard HTTP methods to OTHER, preventing unbounded Prometheus label growth.

statements.why: Only Prometheus label normalization in app/core/metrics/middleware.py:25-35,54-55; no request handling or access change.

misses.what: Fixes a memory-growth/OOM risk: anyone (no login needed) hitting random URLs used to create a new, never-freed Prometheus metric series per distinct path or HTTP method; now unknown paths collapse to '/other' and unknown methods to 'OTHER'.

Metric label values change: /backend-api/... and /internal/... replace the raw paths, and '/', SPA pages, etc. now report as '/other'. Grafana dashboards or alerts keyed on the old path labels will go blank.
